12News KPNX (Phoenix) is your source for breaking news, weather, traffic and live coverage in Phoenix and across the Valley. Get the latest updates from the 12News team—from major local headlines and investigations to severe weather, community stories, and the moments everyone’s talking about.
Watch live newscasts, stream breaking coverage, and catch up on the top stories shaping Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, and surrounding communities.

Subscribe for:
• Phoenix breaking news + live updates
• Arizona weather forecasts and severe weather alerts
• Investigations and accountability reporting
• Community stories across the Valley
• Major events, sports, and local explainers

KPNX—Phoenix news and weather, live and on demand.

🔗 More: https://www.12news.com
